QuestInfo.name: [Eluna Express] Know Your Enemy
QuestInfo.0: Go through the data you gathered about Horntail and discuss it with Eremos.
QuestInfo.1: Eremos believes the energy that manifested in the monsters of Minar Forest could be used to make a buff to enhance stats. In order to test the new buff he created with Horntail's magic, he suggests you go to #m240010600# and defeat 500 #o8140003# monsters.
QuestInfo.2: Eremos's buff helped you successfully defeat the #o8140003# monsters. The strength you gained from the fight makes you confident you can face Horntail.
